classes.name: LDAPServiceAnonBindTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for LDAPService focusing on anonymous binding and configuration changes in LDAP.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Sets up LDAP server configuration before any tests run, skips tests if LDAP server is not configured.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes configuration and data load before each test if not already configured.

methods.name: configureServerAndLoadData
methods.description: Mocks configuration service, binds with admin credentials, and loads fixture data into LDAP for testing.

methods.name: testAnonymousConnection
methods.description: Tests that an LDAPService can perform an anonymous bind successfully.

methods.name: testChangeGlobalConfigUsingAnonymousConnection
methods.description: Ensures that changing LDAP global configuration attributes without admin privileges raises an exception.

methods.name: testChangeGlobalConfigUsingAdminUser
methods.description: Verifies that administrative binding allows modification of LDAP configuration attributes.
